title: Scan the container image against vulnerabilities
description: Scan operating-system packages and application dependencies in container images during build and continuously after publication. Triage findings using exploitability and exposure, enforce remediation targets, and verify deployed image digests. A clean scan does not prove that an image is free of vulnerabilities.

documentation.title: Identify vulnerable container images in your CI/CD workflows

title: Allow deploying containers only from known registries
description: One of the most common custom policies that you might want to consider is to restrict the images that can be deployed in your cluster. But it can also be addressed with a proper egress lockdown or using an admission controller

documentation.title: Use the Azure Policy : Ensure only allowed container images in AKS
Using egress lockdown and authorizing only the URL of your registry

title: Detect and respond to container runtime threats
description: Enable supported runtime threat detection, such as Microsoft Defender for Containers, and route alerts into incident response. Validate required sensors and permissions, investigate suspicious process and network activity, and rehearse containment without assuming a sensor prevents every attack.

title: Prevent promotion of images that violate current policy
description: Continuously rescan stored images and block release promotion or admission when they violate approved risk policy. Verify that quarantine tooling is supported and enforced by every pull path; a registry scan alone does not block deployment.

documentation.title: Prevent promotion of images that violate current policy

title: Scope registry roles to the required repositories and actions
description: Separate image push, pull, delete, signing, and administrative permissions. For ABAC-enabled registries, use supported repository roles and conditions rather than assuming AcrPull/AcrPush applies. Audit assignments and keep the registry admin user disabled.

documentation.title: Scope registry roles to the required repositories and actions

title: Network Segmentation of Docker Registries
description: Limit access to a registry by assigning virtual network private IP addresses to the registry endpoints and using Azure Private Link. Network traffic between the clients on the virtual network and the registry's private endpoints traverses the virtual network and a private link on the Microsoft backbone network, eliminating exposure from the public internet. Private Link also enables enables private registry access from on-premises through Azure ExpressRoute private peering or a VPN gateway.

title: Use minimal, maintained base images
description: Choose supported, regularly patched minimal or distroless images compatible with the application. Do not use end-of-life Debian 10 examples. Removing a shell reduces attack surface but does not prevent exploitation; retain a controlled debug workflow.

title: Refresh container when base image is updated
description: As you use base images for application images, use automation to build new images when the base image is updated. As those base images typically include security fixes, update any downstream application container images.

documentation.title: Automatically build new images on base image update
Azure DevOps - Trigger pipeline from Docker image update

title: Generate SBOMs and verify artifact provenance
description: Generate an SBOM for each release, retain build provenance, and sign immutable artifacts using supported OCI signing tools. Verify signatures and trusted identities during release or admission; signing without verification does not establish a supply-chain control.

documentation.title: Generate SBOMs and verify artifact provenance

title: Retain and replicate the artifacts required for recovery
description: Keep known-good image digests, Helm charts, manifests, and signatures available for the recovery window. Test pulls from the recovery region, registry private DNS, retention rules, and access identities; avoid deleting an image still referenced by production or rollback plans.

documentation.title: Retain and replicate the artifacts required for recovery
